systems.tiers: National fibre backbone from which most Burundian internet service providers get their bandwidth, with 1,250 km of fibre laid; no local government office is said to be on it

note: Internet freedom study to 2019: the term hits are a footnoted news headline naming Mutimbuzi and Kabezi communes; the national backbone is a backbone-class system with no local government office placed on it, so it gives no fact. Nothing on a commune office's connection.
